code:
-- Static filter: only rows where Region = "East" are visible
[Region] = "East"

-- Dynamic filter: compares a column to the signed-in user's identity
[SalesRepEmail] = USERPRINCIPALNAME()
caption: Every RLS role is a DAX expression that evaluates TRUE/FALSE per row — only TRUE rows stay visible to that role's members.
Security is a separate menu item from Manage permissions — permissions control who opens the item, Security controls which rows they see.
Role names and DAX filters come from Desktop; membership is added here, by email address, after the model is published.
The role's … menu offers Test as role — re-rendering the report exactly as a member of that role would see it.

eyebrow: View as… by role or by person
caption: Testing by a specific person confirms their effective permission and assigned roles exactly as that user would experience them.

code:
-- Row-level security: filter predicate + security policy
CREATE FUNCTION Security.tvf_securitypredicate(@SalesRep nvarchar(50))
RETURNS TABLE WITH SCHEMABINDING AS
RETURN SELECT 1 AS result
WHERE @SalesRep = USER_NAME() OR USER_NAME() = 'manager@contoso.com';
GO
CREATE SECURITY POLICY SalesFilter
ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.tvf_securitypredicate(SalesRep)
ON sales.Orders WITH (STATE = ON);

-- Column-level security: plain GRANT
GRANT SELECT ON Customers(CustomerID, FirstName, Phone) TO [charlie@contoso.com];
caption: Independent of the semantic model — this protects anyone querying the Warehouse or SQL analytics endpoint directly.
